'''Elis''' is a maid in the [[Aesdaishar Palace]] in [[Chachin]].

==Appearance==
Elis is pale-haired.

==History==
Elis leads [[Moiraine]] to her rooms after she feels faint when she visits the Palace in {{ne|979}}. She asks the Lady Moiraine Damodred wether she needs anything. After discovering Moiraine's true identity as Aes Sedai when she is approached by [[Merean Redhill]], the newly-raised sister asks to be taken to [[Lan]]'s apartements.{{ref/book|0|25}}
